verdict.rationale: NVIDIA publishes 32 GB of GDDR7 for the RTX 5090, and Tom's Hardware confirms it sits on a 512-bit bus with potent AI performance. The docs also cite FP4 Tensor Core support and a Transformer Engine aimed at LLM inference, and community llama.cpp benchmarks show it running local LLMs with reasonable performance. However, nothing in the evidence shows a 70B-class quantized model fitting or running on a single card, and no memory-bandwidth figure is published. Missing for 10: a published memory-bandwidth spec, direct evidence of 70B-class quantized models running on one card, and independent tokens/sec benchmarks at that model size.
